info.title: Janus public read-only API
info.description: The GET routes of the Janus API that take no body and return no personal data: service status, the FAERS snapshot, the séance catalogue, the light-face overview, validation and export, the time machine, and the open outcome dataset. Medical routes are `no-store`; nothing but an access line (route, status, latency) is logged. Research prototype, not a medical device; not medical advice. Documentation: docs/open-api.md.
